verified_values: Rational Hodge conjecture in every codimension for arbitrary finite mixed products of smooth projective eligible stable-sheaf, twisted-sheaf and generic Bridgeland-stable moduli on complex projective K3 surfaces, including Hilbert schemes and different or repeated bases.

Rational Hodge classes on mixed products of K3 moduli spaces — Alec Kriebel (ORCID 0009-0001-9320-500X). Preprint date: 2026-10-06; production Zenodo publication verified 2026-10-07 UTC. Rational HC in every codimension for finite mixed products of the actual smooth projective Gieseker-stable twisted-sheaf or eligible generic Bridgeland-stable K3 moduli covered by Bülles Theorem 0.1; includes Hilbert schemes, different/repeated bases and explicit empty/zero-dimensional cases. Assembled corollary of OpenAI's audited pinned mixed-K3 theorem and Bülles' established Chow-motive splitting, with Arapura antecedents; no independent base proof, new reduction, firstness or substantial novelty claim. Three distinct complete-package AI adversarial reviews, repairs followed by fresh clean V3; extensive AI use; no conventional human peer review or full Lean formalization. Excludes integral/generalized HC, singular or arbitrary-deformation claims, general abelian-surface moduli and finite-dimensional motives. https://zenodo.org/records/23204176
